key_impacts: Harbor break walls were overtopped/submerged by waves.
Shoreline and nearby city streets were flooded.
Damage reported to shoreline homes/cottages and docks.
Water intake pumps were impacted by large water-level changes.
Water level fluctuations up to 2 m outside the harbor; 0.5 m at the harbor gauge.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor break walls submerged; shoreline and city streets flooded; damage to docks and cottages; water intake pumps impacted.
Reports of 2 m water level fluctuations outside the harbor; the Ludington harbor gauge recorded up to 0.5 m.
missing_information: Counts and monetary value of damages not provided.
Precise impacted extent beyond Ludington not detailed.
